image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal shell plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The coloration is a mix of earthy browns, greens, and greys with mottled patterns. Small white speckles are visible along the edge of the girdle.
